title.en: Your Role in the Group Photo
title.zh: 大家合影：你会怎样凑好这一张？

description.en: Six fictional group-photo choices about a readable frame, a comfortable option to pass and a moment the group actually wants to keep.
description.zh: 六次虚构合影选择，安排好理解的画框、自在跳过的选择，以及大家确实想留下的瞬间。

introduction.en: Imagine taking one casual photo with a willing group. You choose what to arrange and ask before the picture is made or shared. This quiz is about a small social task, not photography skill, appearance or a rating of anyone in the picture.
introduction.zh: 想象与愿意的人拍一张轻松合影。你选择拍摄或分享前安排什么、询问什么。题目只谈小社交任务，不评摄影能力、外貌，也不对入镜的人做价值评价。

focus.en: Coordinating a shared picture through clear composition, participation choices or a bounded moment worth remembering.
focus.zh: 通过清楚构图、参与选择或值得记住的有边界瞬间，协调一张共同照片。

prompt.en: The group proposes a quick photo. You first…
prompt.zh: 大家提议快速合影，你先……

label.en: Check whether everyone who wants to join can be seen.
label.zh: 看看想加入的人能否都被看见。

label.en: Make it easy for anyone to join, step aside or stay out.
label.zh: 让加入、站开或不入镜都容易。

label.en: Ask what small moment the group wants to remember.
label.zh: 问大家想记住哪个小瞬间。

prompt.en: The first arrangement feels awkward. You…
prompt.zh: 第一种排列让人别扭，你会……

label.en: Suggest one simple change in spacing rather than many poses.
label.zh: 提议一个简单间距调整，不连摆许多姿势。

label.en: Offer a relaxed alternative to anyone uncomfortable.
label.zh: 给不舒服的人一个轻松替代方式。

label.en: Use the activity already happening as the picture’s focus.
label.zh: 把正在发生的活动作为画面重点。

prompt.en: Someone does not want to be photographed. You…

label.en: Accept the choice without asking for a reason.
Reframe the willing group without leaving an awkward gap.
label.zh: 给愿意的人重新取景，不刻意留尴尬空位。

label.en: Keep the occasion meaningful without requiring the photo to include everyone.
label.zh: 让活动仍有意义，不要求照片必须含所有人。

prompt.en: There is time for only one more attempt. You prefer…
prompt.zh: 只来得及再拍一次，你更愿……

label.en: A clear simple frame that people can understand quickly.
label.zh: 一个大家很快看懂的简单画框。

label.en: One brief moment around the thing the group made together.
label.zh: 围绕共同做的东西留一个短瞬间。

label.en: Checking who still wants to take part before asking for another pose.
label.zh: 再要求摆姿势前，问谁还愿意参与。

prompt.en: The group asks about sharing the picture. You…
prompt.zh: 大家问怎么分享照片，你会……

label.en: Ask the pictured people what sharing arrangement they want.
label.zh: 问入镜者希望怎样分享。

label.en: Make sure the version being discussed is the actual selected frame.
label.zh: 确认讨论的是实际选中的那张。

label.en: Offer a simple shared caption that fits the occasion.
label.zh: 提供一句贴合场合的简单共同说明。

prompt.en: What would make this photo task feel complete?
prompt.zh: 怎样会让这次合影任务完整？

label.en: We kept one moment and returned to enjoying the occasion.
label.zh: 留住一个瞬间，再回去享受活动。

label.en: People could choose their participation without a fuss.
label.zh: 大家不用费解释就能选参与方式。

label.en: The picture clearly showed what the willing group wanted included.
label.zh: 画面清楚呈现愿意的人想留的内容。

summary.en: Your group photo becomes easier through one clear arrangement people can follow. Spacing and a visible shared focus matter more than a string of complicated poses. The portrait follows this small coordination task rather than judging photographic ability or anybody’s appearance.
summary.zh: 你的合影通过一种大家能跟随的清楚排列变简单。间距与共同焦点，比接连复杂姿势重要。画像只跟随小协调任务，不评摄影能力或任何人的外貌。

example.en: You might suggest standing around the finished craft table so willing participants and the shared work are visible in one uncomplicated picture.
example.zh: 你可能提议围着完成的手工桌站，让愿意的人与共同作品在一张简单画面里都可见。

strength.en: A simple frame can reduce repeated instructions and make the photo a manageable part of the event rather than its main activity.
strength.zh: 简单画框能减少反复指挥，让合影只是活动里好掌握的一部分，不成为主活动。

tradeoff.en: A technically clear frame can still feel uncomfortable to someone in it. Asking about the arrangement keeps composition connected to actual participants.
tradeoff.zh: 技术上清楚的画面，仍可能让入镜者不自在。询问排列，能让构图与实际参与者相连。

experiment.en: For one willing group picture, suggest a single simple arrangement and ask whether it works. Make one adjustment rather than directing every detail.
experiment.zh: 给愿意的群体拍照时，只提一种简单排列，再问是否合适。调整一处，不指挥所有细节。

summary.en: Your picture makes participation a choice people can express without a performance. Joining, staying outside the frame or asking about sharing can all be ordinary parts of the task. A simple shared choice keeps the photo from becoming a test of who belongs in the group.
summary.zh: 你的照片让参与成为不必表演就能表达的选择。加入、留在画外、询问分享，都可作为普通步骤。一个简单共同选择，能让拍照不变成谁属于群体的考试。

example.en: You might say that anyone can step out of a casual picture, then carry on with the willing group without turning the absence into a topic.
example.zh: 你可能说明谁都可不参加轻松合影，再继续拍愿意的人，不把缺席变成话题。

strength.en: A clear option can reduce awkward guessing and let the group keep a picture without treating inclusion in it as proof of belonging.
strength.zh: 清楚选项能减少尴尬猜测，也让群体留影不必把入镜当归属证明。

tradeoff.en: Asking repeatedly after someone has answered can create the pressure the option was meant to remove. Accepting the first clear answer matters too.
tradeoff.zh: 对方已答后还反复问，也会带来原本想去掉的压力。接受第一份清楚回答同样重要。

experiment.en: Before a small group photo, offer a plain option to participate or pass. Accept the response without asking for an explanation or a second decision.
experiment.zh: 一次小合影前，直接说明可参与也可跳过。接受回应，不要求解释或重新决定。

summary.en: Your photo keeps a little of what the group was actually doing together. You prefer one chosen memory to a long sequence of poses. The result does not claim that a picture is necessary for an occasion to matter.
summary.zh: 你的照片保留一点大家实际共同做的事。你偏向一个选中记忆，而非长串摆姿势。结果不宣称活动必须拍照才有意义。

example.en: After a shared model build, you might suggest one picture with the finished piece and then return to the conversation rather than staging another scene.
example.zh: 一起拼完模型，你可能提议与成品拍一张就回去聊天，不再摆另一场景。

strength.en: A bounded memory moment can give the event a small record while leaving most of the time for the experience itself.
strength.zh: 有边界记忆瞬间能留下小记录，也把大部分时间还给体验本身。

tradeoff.en: Choosing a meaningful moment for everyone can be difficult. Asking what people want to keep may work better than selecting the emotional highlight for them.
tradeoff.zh: 替所有人选有意义瞬间并不容易。问大家想留什么，可能比代选情感高潮更合适。

experiment.en: After one willing shared activity, ask whether there is a single moment people want recorded. Let a no-photo ending remain a complete option.
experiment.zh: 一项共同活动后，问是否有一个大家愿记录的瞬间。也让不拍照收尾仍是完整选项。
